theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_cv_slice_fderiv_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x‖ ≤ B ∧ ∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ B * ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x v‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
